title: German-Style Garlic Chicken Paella
description: A twist on the classic Spanish dish, this German-inspired paella recipe incorporates garlic chicken and a hint of Spanish flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the garlic to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the paella rice to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the chicken broth, smoked paprika, and saffron to the skillet.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.
Let the paella rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
